blurb: Guests take private helicopter flights over Ocean City, flying the boardwalk, beach, and coastline north toward Fenwick Island. Flights are family-friendly with no age minimum and children under 24 months fly free on a parent's lap. Tours range from quick hops to ultimate coastal tours with multiple landmarks and altitudes up to 1,500 ft.
